use_case_summary: Build unified research knowledge portal for sell-side and internal analysts: serve full-text search, semantic search via embeddings, and reranking for precision on top results. Must preserve provenance and support highlight snippets. Heavy daily ingestion (batch + streaming), periodic re-index for regulatory docs.
indexing_requirements: Target corpus: 200M-300M documents initially. Need incremental/near-real-time indexing for research alerts. Support content types: PDFs, SEC filings, research notes, scraped news, internal models. Versioned indices for auditability.
sla_targets: P95 query latency target: <=150ms for embedding-only retrieval; end-to-end (retrieve + rerank) <=350ms for 10 results. Availability target 99.95 for dedicated pool.
cost_targets: Goal: ~$0.02-0.03 per query at 5k QPS daily average (batchier during market open). Will trade-off quantization vs. recall; need Optimize recommendations.
technical_constraints: KMS integration mandatory (customer-managed keys), prefer private control plane in VPC. No plaintext vector snapshots to vendor-managed buckets unless encrypted with CMK. Egress must be minimized; recommend regional dedicated capacity.
decision_criteria: 1) Data residency + KMS compliance  2) Predictable pricing at 200M doc scale  3) Latency SLOs with rerank  4) Operational tooling for rollouts and tracing  5) Support SLA and on-call escalation path
